data.one_liner: Web platform implementation of just_audio for audio playback.
data.what_it_does: Provides the web platform-specific implementation for the just_audio package. It is an endorsed plugin, meaning it is automatically included when using just_audio on the web.
use_when: You are using just_audio in a Flutter project targeting the web
You need standard audio playback features implemented for web browsers
avoid_when: You are building a non-web application (though it is endorsed and harmless to include)
You prefer using a different audio playback package such as audioplayers
strengths: Endorsed plugin requires no direct dependency if using just_audio
Seamless integration with the just_audio ecosystem on web
weaknesses: Web audio is subject to browser autoplay policies and CORS restrictions
Not documented beyond being the web implementation of just_audio

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative audio playback library supporting multiple platforms including web.
